about.title: A Family-Oriented Painting Company in Kalamazoo
about.body: Bradley Interior Painting is a family-oriented painting company serving Kalamazoo, Michigan. We take pride in professional workmanship, dependable service, and beautiful results. From interior and exterior painting to drywall hanging, patching, and finishing, we pay attention to the details and our goal is simple: to make every customer happy with the finished work. We're fully insured, and we offer free estimates and free one-year touch-ups.

faqs.a: Yes. You can request a free estimate using the form on this page or by calling (269) 547-3775. Share a few details about your project and we'll take it from there.
Yes, Bradley Interior Painting is fully insured. If you'd like to talk about insurance for your project, just ask when you request your estimate.

faqs.q: Do you offer touch-ups after the job is done?
faqs.a: We offer free touch-ups for one year. Ask us about the details when you request your estimate.
We're based in Kalamazoo, Michigan. If your project is outside Kalamazoo, call (269) 547-3775 or send an estimate request and we'll let you know whether we can help.
We provide interior painting, exterior painting, drywall hanging, drywall patching, and drywall finishing for homes in Kalamazoo, Michigan.

faqs.q: Can you repair drywall before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Drywall patching and finishing are part of what we do, so repairs and painting can be handled together as one project.
